evals.prompt: Send the release coordinator a message on the releases channel saying the smoke test passed.
evals.expected_output: Uses the messages launcher to send the requested text to the releases channel.
expectations: Sends a message through scripts/messages.sh message send.
Uses the releases channel and includes that the smoke test passed.

evals.prompt: Reply to incoming message msg-42 that the migration is complete, and make sure it is not delivered again.
evals.expected_output: Replies through the message command, which atomically closes message msg-42.
expectations: Uses scripts/messages.sh message reply with msg-42.
Includes a completion response and does not separately leave the message unprocessed.

evals.prompt: Ask the build agent on channel build-status whether artifact A-17 is ready, with a five-minute reply deadline.
evals.expected_output: Sends a reply-request through the messages launcher on build-status with the requested text and deadline.
expectations: Uses scripts/messages.sh request with channel build-status and a five-minute deadline.
Requests a reply instead of sending a one-way notification or inventing a direct recipient command.
